**Worth buying if you need a compact station for phones, laptops, lights, or other low-power gear—not for hungry appliances.** The T320 has a 300Wh LiFePO₄ battery, weighs 3.7 kg, and offers two AC outlets, but its inverter is only **200W continuous** (400W surge). That rules out things like kettles and heaters. Recharging is also slow: about 8 hours from the wall, and its 5–24V solar input limits which panels will work. ([Tenergy specs and offer details](https://dealectric.com/tenergy-t320-300wh-power-station))

**Best place to buy:** the **official Tenergy store**, listed at **$225.99** (versus $299.99 at Walmart Business and $249.99 on eBay in the results I found). Check the checkout price before ordering, since prices can change. [Buy from Tenergy](https://power.tenergy.com/tenergy-t320-portable-power-station-300wh-battery-110v-200w-surge-400w-two-pure-sine-wave-ac-outputs-usb-type-c-pd-45w-solar-ready-mobile-power-for-outdoors-camping-vans-rv-hunting-emergency-backup/)

**Bottom line:** At around $226, it’s a reasonable choice if portability and basic backup matter more than output. If you want to run appliances or recharge quickly, I’d look for a more powerful station instead.
